jobs.title: Full Stack Developer Intern – MERN (Unpaid)
jobs.description:
About NoCapCode™

NoCapCode™ is a technology and product development company focused on building scalable digital products, SaaS platforms, internal systems, automation solutions, and modern web applications.
We are looking for a Full Stack Developer Intern with a strong foundation in the MERN stack, backend development, database architecture, and responsive web development.
This opportunity is designed for candidates who want to work on real-world development projects, contribute to existing applications, and gain practical experience with production-oriented engineering practices.

Role Overview

As a Full Stack Developer Intern, you will work across the application stack from developing responsive React interfaces to designing APIs, structuring backend services, and managing databases.
The ideal candidate should understand not only how to write code, but also how different parts of a web application communicate and how a maintainable software architecture is structured.

Key Responsibilities

Develop responsive and scalable web interfaces using React.js
Build and integrate RESTful APIs using Node.js and Express.js
Design and manage MongoDB/Mongoose schemas
Work with SQL databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL
Develop and maintain backend routes, controllers, services, and middleware
Implement frontend state management, props passing, and React Hooks
Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs
Implement authentication, authorization, validation, and error handling
Debug and resolve frontend, backend, API, and database-related issues
Work with existing codebases and understand established project architecture
Write clean, reusable, maintainable, and well-structured code
Use Git/GitHub for version control and collaborative development
Participate in technical discussions, code reviews, testing, and continuous improvement

Required Technical Skills

Frontend

React.js
JavaScript / ES6+
React Hooks
Props, State & Component Lifecycle
Responsive Web Development
HTML5 & CSS3
Tailwind CSS or equivalent
REST API integration

Backend

Node.js
Express.js
REST API development
Routes & Controllers
Middleware
Backend folder architecture
Authentication & Authorization
Request validation
Error handling

Database

MongoDB
Mongoose
Database schema design
CRUD operations
References and relationships
Aggregation pipelines
Basic SQL concepts
MySQL and/or PostgreSQL

Development Tools

Git & GitHub
Postman or equivalent API testing tools
Basic debugging and troubleshooting
Understanding of clean code and modular architecture

What We Expect

The candidate should be able to understand the complete application flow:
Frontend → API → Route → Controller → Service → Schema → Database → Response → Frontend

We particularly value candidates who can:
Understand and improve an existing codebase
Identify architectural and implementation issues
Write reusable components and backend modules
Design appropriate database schemas
Debug problems independently
Learn unfamiliar technologies when required
Communicate clearly with the development team
Take ownership of assigned technical tasks

jobs.title: Frontend Developer Intern | React.js | JavaScript | HTML | CSS
jobs.description:
📢 Hiring | Frontend Developer Intern

Wakeup
is looking for a creative and motivated Frontend Developer Intern
to contribute to the development of responsive, accessible, and user-friendly web interfaces.
This internship is suitable for freshers, students, recent graduates, and aspiring frontend developers
who want to gain practical experience in building modern web applications using core frontend technologies.
Position

Frontend Developer Intern

Core Technologies

• React.js
– Components, props, state, hooks, and reusable UI development
• JavaScript
– ES6+, DOM manipulation, functions, and asynchronous concepts
• HTML
– Semantic structure and accessible web markup
• CSS
– Responsive layouts, Flexbox, Grid, styling, and UI presentation
Key Responsibilities

• Develop and maintain responsive web interfaces using React.js
• Create reusable and modular frontend components
• Implement user-facing features using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
• Convert UI designs and requirements into functional web pages
• Ensure consistent performance and responsiveness across devices
• Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve frontend issues
• Integrate frontend applications with APIs and backend services
• Improve page usability, performance, and cross-browser compatibility
• Participate in testing and debugging of web applications
• Collaborate with developers and team members on ongoing projects
What We’re Looking For

✔️ Strong fundamentals in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
✔️ Basic understanding of React.js and component-based development
✔️ Familiarity with responsive web design principles
✔️ Good problem-solving and logical thinking skills
✔️ Attention to detail and interest in creating quality user interfaces
✔️ Willingness to learn modern frontend development practices
✔️ Academic, personal, or portfolio projects demonstrating frontend skills are a plus
Freshers, students, and recent graduates are encouraged to apply.

📅 Application Deadline

31 August 2026

If you are passionate about Frontend Development
and want to build practical experience with React.js, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
, this internship can help you strengthen your development skills and professional portfolio.
📩 Interested candidates are encouraged to apply before 31 August 2026.
